The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated. The integration of multiple targets and their shared downstream effect on C8166 supports a mechanistic link, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Tetraglyme and C8166.
